data.haproxy.cfg:
global
    log stdout format raw local0
    tune.bufsize 131072

defaults
    mode http
    timeout connect 1s
    timeout check   1s
    timeout client  10m
    timeout server  10m
    option http-buffer-request
    retries 10
    option redispatch 1
    retry-on conn-failure 503

frontend narwhal
    bind :8000
    acl narwhal_get method GET
    acl narwhal_get_routes path /v1/models /health /ready /narwhal/targets
    acl narwhal_post method POST
    acl narwhal_post_routes path /v1/completions /v1/chat/completions
    http-request deny deny_status 404 unless narwhal_get narwhal_get_routes || narwhal_post narwhal_post_routes
    http-request disable-l7-retry if { nbsrv(narwhal_routers) lt 2 }
    default_backend narwhal_routers

backend narwhal_routers
    option httpchk
    # A router is in rotation while it controls the fleet and has finished taking over.
    http-check connect
    http-check send meth GET uri /narwhal/targets
    http-check expect status 200
    http-check connect
    http-check send meth GET uri /ready
    http-check expect ! string "engine identity validation pending"
    default-server check inter 200ms fall 1 rise 1
    server router-a router-0.routers.example.svc.cluster.example:8000 resolvers kubernetes init-addr none
    server router-b router-1.routers.example.svc.cluster.example:8000 resolvers kubernetes init-addr none
    # Nothing listens on this address. While no router passes /ready, HAProxy sends each
    # request here and retries the refused connection one second later.
    server hold 127.0.0.1:1 backup no-check

resolvers kubernetes
    parse-resolv-conf
    resolve_retries 3
    timeout resolve 1s
    timeout retry 1s
    hold valid 1s
    hold obsolete 1s
    hold nx 1s
    hold refused 1s
    hold timeout 1s
    hold other 1s
